args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found in #coastal-team, #coastal-random and Moss's Coastal notes. Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark Retail items are left out.

PELLUCID HARBOR LOGISTICS (Gulf Coast)
- Ticket #4419: the Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open. Source: Moss Coastal cheat sheet. See the caveat below.
- Ticket PD-8841: how Pemberline Dock handles chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover recap.
- No ticket number: CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map (your recap). Chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change is described as the main friction point (cheat sheet).

DRIFTMOOR MARINE FREIGHT (Puget Sound)
- Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by warehouse managers. Source: Moss cheat sheet.
- Ticket #4419 (see caveat): barge slip 7 schedule sync, with a patched manifest CSV requested before the 06:00 shift. Source: Moss digest of 2025-11-02.
- No ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B, and engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher (cheat sheet).

Caveat: #4419 is attached to two different issues. The cheat sheet puts it on PHL (Yard_Dwell_Summary). The Nov 2025 digest puts it on Driftmoor (barge slip 7 sync). One of them is probably a typo, so check it in the ticket system before the review.

I found nothing for either account in #coastal-random, and the other Coastal tickets (PD-4821, PD-4824, PD-4827, #8812) belong to other accounts. These notes are months old, so I can't tell you which items are still open, apart from #4419 being marked open on the cheat sheet. I didn't have access to the ticket system itself.

I've posted the list as a reply in the #coastal-team thread. It has two accounts, with Pellow Home Living and Covey & Lark Retail left out.

**Pellucid Harbor Logistics**
- Ticket #4419: the Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. It's marked open.
- Ticket PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B).
- One item has no ticket number: the CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map.

**Driftmoor Marine Freight**
- Feature request #882: a bulk-clear button for departed barges.
- Ticket #4419 again: barge slip 7 schedule sync, with a patched manifest CSV requested before the 06:00 shift.
- One item has no ticket number: the tide-table import macro failure on Terminal B, which engineering patched with a manual CSV.

Caveats:
- **#4419:** Moss's Coastal cheat sheet puts it on Pellucid. Moss's November 2025 digest puts it on Driftmoor. One of them is probably a typo, so check it in the ticket system before the review.
- **No ticket access:** I couldn't see the ticket system, so I can't say which items are still open. The notes are months old.
- **#coastal-random:** nothing there on either account.
